name: CrossSignalAgreement_GT
description: Signals remain aligned over time (ground truth).
epl: @Name('CrossSignalAgreement_GT') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and (a1.value - b1.value < 1.2 and a1.value - b1.value > -1.2) and (a1.value - c1.value < 1.2 and a1.value - c1.value > -1.2) and (b1.value - c1.value < 1.2 and b1.value - c1.value > -1.2) and (a2.value - b2.value < 1.2 and a2.value - b2.value > -1.2) and (a2.value - c2.value < 1.2 and a2.value - c2.value > -1.2) and (b2.value - c2.value < 1.2 and b2.value - c2.value > -1.2)

name: CrossSignalAgreement_OBS
description: Observed signals remain aligned over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalAgreement_OBS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and (a1.value - b1.value < 1.2 and a1.value - b1.value > -1.2) and (a1.value - c1.value < 1.2 and a1.value - c1.value > -1.2) and (b1.value - c1.value < 1.2 and b1.value - c1.value > -1.2) and (a2.value - b2.value < 1.2 and a2.value - b2.value > -1.2) and (a2.value - c2.value < 1.2 and a2.value - c2.value > -1.2) and (b2.value - c2.value < 1.2 and b2.value - c2.value > -1.2)

name: CrossSignalAgreement_SYS
description: System signals remain aligned over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalAgreement_SYS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and (a1.value - b1.value < 1.2 and a1.value - b1.value > -1.2) and (a1.value - c1.value < 1.2 and a1.value - c1.value > -1.2) and (b1.value - c1.value < 1.2 and b1.value - c1.value > -1.2) and (a2.value - b2.value < 1.2 and a2.value - b2.value > -1.2) and (a2.value - c2.value < 1.2 and a2.value - c2.value > -1.2) and (b2.value - c2.value < 1.2 and b2.value - c2.value > -1.2)

name: CrossSignalDivergence_GT
description: Signals diverge consistently over time (ground truth).
epl: @Name('CrossSignalDivergence_GT') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a1.value > b1.value + 1.5 or a1.value < b1.value - 1.5) or (a1.value > c1.value + 1.5 or a1.value < c1.value - 1.5) or (b1.value > c1.value + 1.5 or b1.value < c1.value - 1.5)) and ((a2.value > b2.value + 1.5 or a2.value < b2.value - 1.5) or (a2.value > c2.value + 1.5 or a2.value < c2.value - 1.5) or (b2.value > c2.value + 1.5 or b2.value < c2.value - 1.5))

name: CrossSignalDivergence_OBS
description: Observed signals diverge consistently over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalDivergence_OBS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a1.value > b1.value + 1.5 or a1.value < b1.value - 1.5) or (a1.value > c1.value + 1.5 or a1.value < c1.value - 1.5) or (b1.value > c1.value + 1.5 or b1.value < c1.value - 1.5)) and ((a2.value > b2.value + 1.5 or a2.value < b2.value - 1.5) or (a2.value > c2.value + 1.5 or a2.value < c2.value - 1.5) or (b2.value > c2.value + 1.5 or b2.value < c2.value - 1.5))

name: CrossSignalDivergence_SYS
description: System signals diverge consistently over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalDivergence_SYS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a1.value > b1.value + 1.5 or a1.value < b1.value - 1.5) or (a1.value > c1.value + 1.5 or a1.value < c1.value - 1.5) or (b1.value > c1.value + 1.5 or b1.value < c1.value - 1.5)) and ((a2.value > b2.value + 1.5 or a2.value < b2.value - 1.5) or (a2.value > c2.value + 1.5 or a2.value < c2.value - 1.5) or (b2.value > c2.value + 1.5 or b2.value < c2.value - 1.5))

name: CrossSignalTrendConsistency_GT
description: Signals move in the same direction over time (ground truth).
epl: @Name('CrossSignalTrendConsistency_GT') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a2.value > a1.value and b2.value > b1.value and c2.value > c1.value) or (a2.value < a1.value and b2.value < b1.value and c2.value < c1.value))

name: CrossSignalTrendConsistency_OBS
description: Observed signals move in the same direction over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalTrendConsistency_OBS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a2.value > a1.value and b2.value > b1.value and c2.value > c1.value) or (a2.value < a1.value and b2.value < b1.value and c2.value < c1.value))

name: CrossSignalTrendConsistency_SYS
description: System signals move in the same direction over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalTrendConsistency_SYS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a2.value > a1.value and b2.value > b1.value and c2.value > c1.value) or (a2.value < a1.value and b2.value < b1.value and c2.value < c1.value))

name: CrossSignalRelativeStable_GT
description: Relative differences between signals remain stable over time (ground truth).
epl: @Name('CrossSignalRelativeStable_GT') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='ground_truth') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='ground_truth') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='ground_truth'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a1.value - b1.value) - (a2.value - b2.value) < 0.3 and (a1.value - b1.value) - (a2.value - b2.value) > -0.3) and ((b1.value - c1.value) - (b2.value - c2.value) < 0.3 and (b1.value - c1.value) - (b2.value - c2.value) > -0.3)

name: CrossSignalRelativeStable_OBS
description: Relative differences between observed signals remain stable over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalRelativeStable_OBS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated')) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus='validated') and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus='validated') and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus='validated'))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a1.value - b1.value) - (a2.value - b2.value) < 0.3 and (a1.value - b1.value) - (a2.value - b2.value) > -0.3) and ((b1.value - c1.value) - (b2.value - c2.value) < 0.3 and (b1.value - c1.value) - (b2.value - c2.value) > -0.3)

name: CrossSignalRelativeStable_SYS
description: Relative differences between system signals remain stable over time.
epl: @Name('CrossSignalRelativeStable_SYS') select a1, b1, c1, a2, b2, c2 from pattern [every (a1=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b1=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c1=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed'))) -> (a2=Event(src='dt-1', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and b2=Event(src='dt-2', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')) and c2=Event(src='dt-3', eventStatus in ('validated','reconstructed')))] where a1.eventTs < a2.eventTs and ((a1.value - b1.value) - (a2.value - b2.value) < 0.3 and (a1.value - b1.value) - (a2.value - b2.value) > -0.3) and ((b1.value - c1.value) - (b2.value - c2.value) < 0.3 and (b1.value - c1.value) - (b2.value - c2.value) > -0.3)
